name: Isaszeg (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Isaszeg: a yellow shield with a blue-clad soldier on a green mound, above a scroll inscribed ISASZEG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
